cmd: out=$(Rscript R/ch1/12_aaa_formats.R --check 2>&1); rc=$?; printf "%s\n" "$out"; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then printf "%s\n" "$out" | uv run --locked python -c 'import re, sys; t = sys.stdin.read(); F = lambda c, m: c or sys.exit("W3.9 FAIL: " + m); fl = re.findall(r"^FAIL\s+(S\d|\S+)\s+(.*)$", t, re.M); I = sorted({f[0] for f in fl}); cov = re.findall(r"^RECORD\s+coverage (\d{4})\s+([\d,]+) of ([\d,]+) Final games on disk", t, re.M); sh = [x for x in cov if int(x[1].replace(",", "")) < int(x[2].replace(",", ""))]; F(fl, "the check exited non-zero with no FAIL clause"); F(set(I) <= {"S1", "S2", "S4"}, "a clause other than S1, S2 or S4 failed: " + ", ".join(i for i in I if i not in ("S1", "S2", "S4"))); F(len(cov) == 3, "the coverage records for 2023, 2024 and 2025 are missing"); F(sh, "the AAA corpus is complete, so the deferral has lapsed: S1, S2 and S4 must pass or be amended by a recorded decision"); [print("DEFERRED-PENDING-AAA-PULL %s %s" % f) for f in fl]; print("W3.9 DEFERRED-PENDING-AAA-PULL: %s fail on a partial AAA corpus (%s); every other clause passes or is PENDING; the deferral lapses once the AAA pull (fleet phase 07) completes the corpus, and does not waive S1, S2 or S4" % (", ".join(I), "; ".join("%s %s of %s Final games on disk" % x for x in cov)))' || exit 1; fi; uv run --locked python tests/guard/gd04_scan.py --path R/ch1/12_aaa_formats.R
title: AAA format classification
